subject: Pillar lead rotation + QBR slate — confirmation & handover plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pillar lead rotation + QBR slate — confirmation & handover plan

Team —

Per our leadership sync last week, we want to rotate pillar stewardship across two squads for the next QBR cycle to broaden leadership experience and reduce single-person dependencies in Platform and Ops. Attached: rotation_matrix.xlsx (proposed assignments) and qbr_agenda_v1.docx (initial talking points). High-level ask: please confirm your acceptance (or flag concerns) by end of day Thursday so we can finalize the QBR slide deck and canary comms.

Rationale (short):
- Cross-pollinate critical knowledge ahead of H2 hiring pause
- Reduce risk for on-call bottlenecks by distributing product knowledge
- Create clearer succession pathways for Pillar CTO review

What I need from each of you:
1) Confirm if you can take on the interim pillar lead role (see matrix)
2) If yes, list 2 concrete handoff items you need from the outgoing lead (docs, runbooks, key contacts)
3) Volunteer a 2-week overlap window for knowledge transfer (preferred dates in the matrix)

QBR ask: each interim lead will present a 7–10 minute section: current health (SWOT), 1–2 high-impact asks (resourcing/decisions), and 2 success metrics for the next quarter. We'll consolidate slides after confirmations.

FF: tentative schedule: confirm by Thu 9/23; slide consolidation Fri 9/24; dry run Tue 9/28.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Platform Strategy, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Attachments: rotation_matrix.xlsx, qbr_agenda_v1.docx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pillar lead rotation + QBR slate — confirmation & handover plan

Naomi —

Thanks for the clear ask. I reviewed the matrix and I can take the interim lead for the Serving pillar for the two-quarter rotation. A few quick items/questions:

- Handover needs: access to the serving runtime tuning notes, the current kernel selection matrix, and the latest infra-cost model (cost/per-token assumptions). If 'outgoing lead' (Patrick) can drop those into the shared Drive folder, I can prioritize the runbook read-through.
- Overlap window: 10/4–10/15 works best for me (two-week block).
- QBR slide: I suggest we call out an explicit latency improvement target if we push quantization/tuning — otherwise the ask will sound nebulous. I can draft the draft slide if someone else consolidates.

On the schedule: I may need a 15–20 minute one-on-one with Patrick during week 1 of overlap for the KV-cache edge cases.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pillar lead rotation + QBR slate — confirmation & handover plan

Naomi / team —

I support the rotation but want to propose a slight change to reduce risk during the handover: staggered rotations rather than simultaneous swaps. Practical reasons:
- Some pillars (Serving, Runtime) are mid-rollout on infra changes; simultaneous swaps could mean knowledge gaps during a live launch.
- A 1-week stagger allows the first interim lead to handle any post-launch fallout before the second transition begins.

Suggested approach: Jonas begins 10/4; my handover window is 10/11–10/22 (so there is a 1-week overlap with Jonas post-start). Soojin can confirm her dates but the stagger block reduces on-call pressure and gives us time for documented runbook validation.

I've attached a short handover-checklist.md that covers operational runbook sections, on-call escalation paths, and a simple test checklist for the first week post-handover. Also: for QBR slides, I think we should call out medium-term resourcing asks separate from immediate infra requests — helps leadership prioritize.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Platform Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pillar lead rotation + QBR slate — confirmation & handover plan

Thanks all — helpful notes and fast responses. Quick summary and next steps: 

1) Confirmed assignments: Jonas -> Serving (starts 10/4), Marissa -> Runtime Ops (starts 10/11), Soojin -> Observability pillar remains but will co-lead the incident post-mortem cadence for the rotation period. I updated rotation_matrix.xlsx in Drive.

2) Stagger: we will adopt Marissa's suggested 1-week stagger to reduce on-call overlaps. Jonas and Marissa — please coordinate a 30-minute alignment with the outgoing leads (Patrick and L. Hernandez) to collect the handover artifacts.

3) Handover artifacts (min): runbooks, kernel-selection notes, cost model sheet, contact list for infra vendors. Please drop into the Drive folder and tag with "handover-2026Q4".

4) QBR slides: Jonas, draft Serving slide with explicit latency/cost targets; Marissa, draft Runtime Ops slide with two success metrics and one medium-term resourcing ask. I'll consolidate slides on Fri 9/24 and schedule a 45-minute dry run on Tue 9/28 at 10:00.

5) Action items (owners):
- Jonas: draft slide + list of two runbook items needed from Patrick (due 9/23 EOD)
- Marissa: upload handover checklist + confirm overlap dates with outgoing lead (due 9/23 EOD)
- Soojin: review observability docs for gaps and add any missing dashboards (due 9/24)
- Naomi: finalize consolidated QBR deck and send to Execs by Mon 9/27

If anything blocks these timelines, flag me directly. If no objections I will send a short comm to all affected ICs and team mailing lists tomorrow morning.

Best —
Naomi
Head of Platform Strategy, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: rotation_matrix.xlsx, handover-checklist.md, qbr_agenda_v1.docx
